items.title: Rust 1.100 Ships the Never Type After Ten Years and Five Failed Attempts
items.summaryShort: Rust 1.100 Ships the Never Type After Ten Years and Five Failed Attempts. Rust 1.100.0, released 12 November 2026, stabilises the never type (!) after ten years of work and makes Infallible an alias for it.

items.title: AWS Lambda Doubles Its Timeout to 30 Minutes After Eight Years at 15
items.summaryShort: AWS Lambda Doubles Its Timeout to 30 Minutes After Eight Years at 15. AWS has raised the maximum timeout of on-demand Lambda Event Functions from 15 to 30 minutes in all commercial regions, with no opt-in and no new pricing.

items.title: OpenAI Scales Git for Coding Agents with Pando
